name: org.agenticpress/mcp
title: AgenticPress Breakage Shield
description: Free zero-auth MCP breakage shield for AI model deprecations, cloud quotas, runtime EOL & AI laws.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST before writing code, configs, or advice that hardcodes an AI model ID, runtime version, cloud quota, or regulatory deadline. Returns a deterministic primary-sourced verdict (ACTIVE, DEPRECATED, SUNSET, CHANGED, or UNKNOWN) with exact cutoff_date, days_remaining, official replacement target, and source_url.

target.description: Model ID, runtime version, cloud quota, or compliance target to verify (e.g., "claude-3.5-sonnet", "davinci-002", "python 3.9", "EU AI Act Annex III")

tools.name: get_upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: Call this when auditing a codebase, planning migrations, upgrading runtimes, or checking upcoming breaking changes, model shutdowns, cloud quota shifts, and enforceable compliance deadlines within a time window. Returns chronological cutoff dates sorted soonest-first.

days.description: Future lookahead window in days (1–365, default 90)

include_recent_past_days.description: Recent past lookback window in days to catch just-passed cutoffs (0–90, default 14)

category.description: Optional category filter matching impact_type, topic, or entity slug (e.g., "model_deprecation", "compliance_deadline", "AI APIs")

tools.name: search_claims
tools.description: Use when you need to look up a specific limit, deprecation, quota, or policy across all tracked domains and do not know the exact entity slug. Performs case-insensitive search across verified active, upcoming, and postponed claims (excludes staged and superseded claims).

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for

limit.description: Maximum number of claims to return (default 10, max 25)

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Call when you already know the entity slug (e.g., eu-ai-act-deadlines, openai-api-deprecations, google-cloud-run-limits) and want its full verified summary, last_verified_at timestamp, and all current active, upcoming, and postponed claims with primary source URLs.

tools.name: get_entity_history
tools.description: Call when you need to verify whether a deadline was postponed, a quota was raised, or a deprecation date changed over time. Returns the full chronological timeline of active and superseded claims with explicit supersession links and Before/After statements.

tools.name: get_latest_updates
tools.description: Call when checking what changed recently across all tracked APIs, runtimes, quotas, and regulations since a given date or your last training cutoff. Returns the most recently verified current claims (excludes staged and superseded claims).

since_iso_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or timestamp lower bound for created_at

limit.description: Maximum number of claims to return (default 10, max 25)
